before.scope: Targeted recovery-state snapshot, not a full database backup

firstAttempt.preservationScope: Only rows present in the targeted baseline; rows outside it are not new-row counts
limitations: Quote authenticity is checked against stored provider/source/bookmaker flags, frozen shared vectors and timestamps; no provider request is made by this audit.
The prepared decisions_hash is preserved and checked for format; it is not independently reconstructed from post-admission decision snapshots.
Two matching SELECT snapshots detect observed concurrent changes; no database transaction or external lock is acquired.
Original research origin records are read for lineage; only the execution/accounting tables present in the supplied baseline have a before/after preservation proof.
